title: Submatrix on chosen rows and columns
statement: Let $R$ be a ring and $A=(a_{ij})_{i\in I,\,j\in J}$ an $I\times J$ matrix with entries in $R$ [def-weil-matrix]. For subsets $I'\subseteq I$ and $J'\subseteq J$, the submatrix of $A$ on the rows $I'$ and the columns $J'$ is the $I'\times J'$ matrix $(a_{ij})_{i\in I',\,j\in J'}$. It is finite when $I'$ and $J'$ are finite, and square of size $k$ when moreover $|I'|=|J'|=k$; for $I=J=\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ a finite square submatrix of size $k$ is $(a_{r_x s_y})_{1\leq x,y\leq k}$ for indices $r_1<\cdots<r_k$ and $s_1<\cdots<s_k$.
